header.title: On the beach, at the quiet end of the island
header.intro: Every time we cross the Causeway into Galveston, a weight lifts and the mind starts to clear. Solarus sits directly on the beach along Termini-San Luis Pass Road, on the west end of the island.
header.imageAlt: Galveston beach dunes with the Gulf behind

landmark.title: An island with deep roots
landmark.body: Galveston has deep historical roots, and generations have felt the same inner peace and warmth when experiencing its beauty. The Pleasure Pier, the Strand and the Seawall are a short drive up the island; Solarus sits on the quieter west end, along one of the most tranquil stretches of the island.
landmark.imageAlt: Watercolor of the Galveston Pleasure Pier and its Ferris wheel seen from above
